title: Show low-stock badge on product page
description: As a shopper I want to see when an item is almost sold out so that I can decide to buy it before it runs out.
acceptance_criteria: When stock is between 1 and 5, the product page shows 'Only N left' with the current count
When stock is 0, the page shows 'Out of stock' and the Add to cart button is disabled
When stock is above 5, no badge is shown
The badge updates when the page is refreshed after a stock change
